label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: The Skip to main content link did nothing visible: focus stayed on the link and the next Tab went to the other skip links and the header again. Keyboard users cannot bypass the header.

findings.page: Search results and product pages of the shop
findings.problem: After every page load, focus was reset to the top of the page, so about 25 Tab presses through banners, alerts, logo, search and account links were needed before reaching any content, on each new page.

The product tile image link had no accessible name (announced only as link), so I could not tell it opened the speaker product until I pressed Enter. Other header controls (logo link) were also unnamed.

Between the page header and the Add to cart button there were roughly 40 Tab stops: sticky section links, gallery arrows, zoom, two sets of video player controls (volume, progress bar, audio description, audio track, share) and rating buttons. Auto-playing video controls repeated and some were unnamed divs. I ran out of steps just reaching Add to cart.

A promotional email popup appeared after load and took focus when I moved backwards; it had a Dismiss button but the popup was at the end of the page order. After activating Add to cart there was no visible confirmation, cart count or focus move, so I could not tell whether the item was added.
